result.description:
Location: Palmerston, Northern Territory
Employment type: Full-time
Hours: 38 hours per week
Salary: $67,510 to $72,000 plus superannuation

About us
Skills and Hands NT Pty Ltd is a Northern Territory-based consultancy focused on workforce planning, talent engagement, and sustainable staffing strategies. We work alongside local businesses to support the development of strong, reliable teams through tailored pathways that align with their long-term goals. Our role is to facilitate practical workforce solutions that help employers attract and retain skilled talent—contributing to the resilience and continuity of operations across the Territory.

About the business
The business (ABN 91 213 951 452) is a takeaway food outlet located in a busy shopping centre food court in Palmerston, serving a range of freshly prepared takeaway meals, including loaded chips, fish and chips, fried chicken, seafood baskets, hotdogs, ice cream and milkshakes.

The successful applicant will oversee the outlet's front-of-house retail operations and support its smooth daily operation. 

About the Role
The Retail Supervisor will supervise and coordinate the activities of staff, maintain high customer service standards and assist management with staff supervision, stock control, cash handling and the day-to-day operation of the outlet. 

The position requires availability across a rotating roster, including weekends, public holidays and evening shifts where required.

Key Responsibilities
- Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of counter and staff.
- Allocate duties and prepare or assist with staff rosters.
- Ensure customers receive prompt, friendly and accurate service.
- Train staff in customer service, point-of-sale procedures, food handling and workplace requirements.
- Monitor staff performance and provide day-to-day guidance and support.
- Respond to customer enquiries, concerns and complaints.
- Operate and supervise point-of-sale and cash-handling procedures.
- Complete opening and closing procedures, including cash reconciliation.
- Monitor stock levels and assist with stocktaking and ordering.
- Receive and check deliveries against orders.
- Ensure menu items, promotional materials and prices are correctly displayed.
- Maintain the cleanliness and presentation of the service counter, customer areas and retail displays.
- Ensure food safety, workplace health and safety, security and hygiene procedures are followed.
- Report staffing, stock, equipment and operational issues to management.
- Assist with counter service and other operational duties during busy periods.

Skills and Experience
The successful applicant must have:
- At least one year of relevant experience in retail, takeaway food, fast food or a similar customer-service environment;
- Previous experience supervising or coordinating staff;
- Experience with point-of-sale systems, cash handling and daily reconciliations;
- Good customer service and complaint-handling skills;
- The ability to organise staff and prioritise duties during busy service periods;
- Knowledge of stock control and basic inventory procedures;
- Good communication and interpersonal skills;
- A reliable, organised and hands-on approach to work; and
- The ability to work weekends, public holidays and shifts according to the business roster.
- A current food-safety or food-handling certificate is desirable.

How to Apply
To apply, submit the following:
- Resume outlining your work experience and references.
- A short cover letter (max. 300 words) explaining:
- Why you are applying for this position; and
- An example of when you showed excellent service, initiative, or teamwork (use the STAR method: Situation, Task, Action, Result).
- A Written Response (max. 600 words) describing how your skills and experience align with the responsibilities of the role you are applying for. Please structure your example(s) using the STAR method.

* Only complete applications that address all three components will be considered. Incomplete or generic submissions will not be shortlisted.

If you are interested in joining a busy and growing takeaway food business serving the Palmerston community, we look forward to receiving your application.

Apply online only. Walk-in or telephone enquiries regarding this vacancy will not be accepted.

Applications close: 20 August 2026

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     HammondCare Waratah is currently looking for a Weekend Cook-Chef to join our team.

HammondCare has a unique model of care which places the resident's needs as our number one priority.

As a part of the Support Service's Team, you will support our model of care by delivering high quality meals within the MAIN KITCHEN at our Waratah Facility catering for our 232 residents in accordance with the organisational mission and mission in action statement.

Core Responsibilities:

Reporting to the Support Services Manager you will be responsible for;

Preparing nourishing, appetising, and culturally appropriate meals that meet individual dietary needs and preferences. This includes ensuring meals are visually appealing and served at the correct portion size and temperature.

Ensuring strict adherence to the Food Safety Program (FSP), HACCP standards, and all relevant health and safety regulations. This also involves complying with the Aged Care Quality Standards, specifically Standard 6: Food and nutrition.

Preparing residents' specific dietary requirements, including texture-modified food for those with swallowing difficulties (dysphagia).

Responding to feedback and addressing concerns promptly.

Maintaining accurate documentation related to food safety, resident dietary needs, and operational data.

To be successful in this role, you will:

Be flexible and able to commit to a range of shifts including weekends.

Value teamwork but also be able to work independently and show initiative.

Must have experience in cooking for large numbers in a commercial kitchen and or an aged care environment.

Have an understanding of The vulnerable persons guidelines for food safety or willingness to learn and incorporate these into your everyday work routine.

Demonstrated understanding of safe manual handling practices.

Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Experience in preparing and cooking bulk meals.

What are the benefits of working with HammondCare?

Flexible working environment to deliver a healthy work-life balance.

Gain access to multiple health and fitness facilities at a low fee with Fitness Passport

Be supported & empowered in your role to really make a difference to our residents.

A workplace trainer on each site committed to your ongoing training & development.

Access to not-for-profit salary sacrificing arrangements.

Shift times.

0630-1500

0900-1730

About HammondCare:

HammondCare is an independent Christian charity that has been serving families in Australia since 1932. We are an organisation that is led by our values, our passion is improving the quality of care for people in need.

As one of Australia's most innovative health & aged care providers, we champion life for every person in our care.

HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves.

APMG Services is seeking a full-time Digital Content Creator / Social Media & Videography professional to support the business’s digital marketing and brand communications.

Key responsibilities include:
• Creating, editing, scheduling and publishing written, photographic and video content for social media and digital platforms.
• Planning social media content and maintaining content calendars.
• Supporting digital advertising and brand-awareness campaigns.
• Monitoring social-media and campaign performance and preparing reports.
• Analysing audience engagement and using insights to improve future content.
• Coordinating content releases and keeping website and social-media material current.
• Working with internal stakeholders to ensure content supports business objectives and brand requirements.

This is a permanent full-time position, 38 hours per week. The salary is $80,000 per annum plus superannuation. Applicants should have relevant experience in digital content creation, social media content planning, photography, videography, video editing, content scheduling, campaign monitoring and audience engagement analysis.

result.description:
Office Manager
Business: SAINI INDUSTRIES PTY LTD
Location: 2 Blaikie Road, Jamisontown NSW 2750
Employment Type: Full-time, Ongoing
Salary: AUD $75,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation
Full Job Description
About the Business
SAINI INDUSTRIES PTY LTD is an Australian-owned manufacturing and industrial services business based in Jamisontown, New South Wales. The company provides manufacturing, fabrication, and industrial support services to commercial and industrial clients while maintaining high standards of operational efficiency, workplace safety, and customer service.
Operating within a dynamic manufacturing environment, the business coordinates production activities, procurement, inventory management, customer service, supplier relationships, and administrative functions. As the business continues to expand, there is an increasing need for structured administrative management to ensure efficient office operations, effective communication across departments, regulatory compliance, and ongoing operational support.
To support these operational requirements, SAINI INDUSTRIES PTY LTD is seeking to appoint a dedicated full-time Office Manager.

About the Role
The Office Manager is responsible for organising and controlling the functions and resources of the office, including administrative systems, office personnel, records management, and operational support. The role is critical to ensuring the efficient administration of the business through effective planning, coordination of office services, workforce management, compliance, and continuous improvement of administrative procedures.
The successful applicant will demonstrate strong organisational, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills and be capable of managing multiple administrative priorities within a busy industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities
The successful applicant will be responsible for:
•	Contributing to the planning, development, review, and continuous improvement of office services, while establishing priorities and office service standards.
•	Organising and allocating office resources, including human resources, workspace, equipment, and administrative support to ensure efficient business operations.
•	Assigning work to administrative employees, monitoring work performance, and providing ongoing guidance and supervision.
•	Managing office records, administrative documentation, accounts, and confidential business information while ensuring accuracy and security.
•	Liaising with management, accountants, suppliers, contractors, customers, and other professionals to coordinate office activities and facilitate the resolution of operational issues.
•	Ensuring office equipment, facilities, and supplies are properly maintained, serviced, and replenished.
•	Monitoring compliance with Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) requirements and promoting safe administrative practices.
•	Ensuring office operations comply with relevant Commonwealth and State legislation, organisational policies, and company procedures.
•	Coordinating personnel activities including recruitment, onboarding, payroll administration, performance management, staff training, promotions, leave administration, and supervision.
•	Preparing reports, maintaining administrative systems, supporting budgeting processes, and recommending improvements to enhance office efficiency and operational performance.

Requirements
Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents are encouraged to apply.
Applicants should possess:
•	AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma, or Diploma in Business Administration, Office Management, Management, or a closely related discipline.
OR
•	At least three years of relevant work experience may substitute for formal qualifications.
Applicants should also demonstrate:
•	Experience in office management or a similar administrative leadership position.
•	Strong organisational, planning, and time management skills.
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
•	High-level proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
•	Ability to coordinate office personnel and manage competing priorities.
•	Experience maintaining administrative systems, records, and business documentation.
•	Knowledge of workplace health and safety requirements and relevant legislative obligations.
•	Ability to work independently while supporting senior management and coordinating administrative operations.

Work Conditions
•	Full-time, ongoing position.
•	Work location: 2 Blaikie Road, Jamisontown NSW 2750.
•	Salary: AUD $75,000 – $80,000 per annum plus superannuation.
•	Opportunity to work with an established Australian manufacturing business in a professional and supportive environment.
Note: Preference will be given to suitably qualified Australian Citizens and Permanent Residents.
